description: Discovery feed: list of entities with activity in 2+ regulatory verticals (SEC + FDA + contracts) inside the lookback window. Use to find entities worth pulling a full cross-vertical timeline for.

days.description: Calendar-day lookback for dated source activity; some sources have no date filter. Default 90, max 365.

limit.description: Maximum entities returned; default 50, server caps at 100.

min_verticals.description: Minimum distinct source families with activity per entity; default 2, allowed 2 to 4.

name: cross_vertical_active
title: Find Cross-Dataset Activity
